meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 的 GitHub 机器人账号就能参与仓库里的 PR/Issue 评论:评论里 @它,它就在当前评论串回复;被 @过的讨论串,后续评论也会继续回应。
howto.when: 当 GitHub 上有 PR/Issue 或评审评论通过 Webhook 到达,且评论里 @到了配置好的机器人账号时触发;机器人自己发的评论会被忽略。同一讨论串首次被 @后,后续评论也继续触发。

say.text: @机器人 这个 PR 改了什么?
say.note: 它会在当前 PR 评论串里回复。

say.text: @机器人 你怎么看这条 issue 的讨论?
say.note: 它进入该 issue 的评论线程回应。

say.text: @机器人 这条线程的后续新评论继续跟进。
say.note: 这条 @ 会订阅该串,之后自动触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw adds a GitHub channel through a bot account: it joins PR and issue comment threads, replies when someone @-mentions it, and keeps responding to further comments on threads where it has already been mentioned.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a GitHub PR/issue or review comment @-mentions the configured bot account via webhook. Bot-authored comments are ignored. After the first mention, later comments on that thread trigger too.

say_en.note: It replies in the current PR thread.

say_en.text: @bot How do you read the discussion on this issue?
say_en.note: It responds inside that issue thread.

say_en.text: @bot Keep following this thread for new comments.
say_en.note: That mention subscribes the thread; later comments trigger automatically.
